scope: Make the existing application database the single active runtime-instructions Markdown document store. Seed a new installation once without replacing an existing document, validate and snapshot accepted documents server-side, and reject stale Settings saves. No GoDaddy application, database, migration, reset, deletion, deployment or external upload was contacted.

checks.name: single database document semantics
checks.observed: The installation seed creates one document, a valid edit changes its revision, later initialization preserves that edit, and a write with a stale revision is rejected.
checks.limit: This uses the local memory-store seam; hosted MySQL durability remains a release check.

checks.name: authenticated Settings API and immutable run snapshot
checks.observed: A signed-in owner receives a database-sourced document, saves a valid revision, receives a 422 for invalid Markdown and a 409 for a stale revision, and an accepted run retains only its accepted Markdown/revision snapshot.
checks.limit: The isolated HTTP fixture uses the local memory store and an unavailable provider.

checks.name: local browser Settings review
checks.evidence: isolated local app at http://127.0.0.1:4324/ in the Codex in-app browser
checks.observed: After local sign-in and consent, Settings labelled the document as the single database-stored Markdown source. Replacing a Direct Head Answer sentence and saving produced a new database document revision and future-consultations confirmation.
checks.limit: This is local in-app-browser evidence only. It does not verify Safari, Chrome, hosted MySQL, a live provider or production deployment.
